metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented the MARC 21 command-line tool in [output/](/workspace/output). It supports all four actions, UTF-8 ISO 2709 and MARCXML conversion, embedded validation rules, and structured errors. The [Cargo manifest](/workspace/output/Cargo.toml) has no dependencies.

Verified the release build, `cargo run --release`, and all four unit tests.
